info.title: USAspending API Awards: federal contract and grant awards
info.description:
Who won federal contracts and grants, and for how much? Pulls USAspending awards by agency, recipient, NAICS and period, with award IDs and source links.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper
Author: Public Records.

tags.name: runs
tags.description: Start a run and read dataset items

post.description: Starts the Actor asynchronously. Poll the returned run, then read dataset items. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper

schema.title: USASpending Awards Scraper
schema.description: Public USASpending.gov spending_by_award API. Defaults to recent contracts/IDVs (A–D) over the last 30 days. Emphasize agency / recipient / date filters.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Mapped to filters.keywords. Leave empty for broad recent awards; prefer agency/recipient/date.

agency.title: Awarding agency (toptier name)
agency.description: Toptier awarding agency name → filters.agencies[{type:awarding,tier:toptier,name}]. Example: Department of Defense.

recipient.title: Recipient name
recipient.description: Mapped to filters.recipient_search_text (array). Example: Boeing. Verified shape requires an array of strings.

awardTypes.title: Award type codes
awardTypes.description: Default A,B,C,D (contracts/IDVs). Avoid assistance codes that may list individuals.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today − 30 days (recent awards window).

subawards.title: Subawards mode
subawards.description: Pass subawards flag to search (default false).

fetchDetails.title: Fetch award details
fetchDetails.description: Hydrate via GET /awards/{generated_internal_id}/. Still one PPE charge.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Cap on award rows (deduped by awardId|generatedInternalId).

post.summary: Run publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper and return dataset items
post.description: Synchronous convenience endpoint. Waits for the run to finish and returns dataset items.
